{{Top|leg}}
A '''neurospecialist''' was a type of [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]]. A team of neurospecialists were based aboard the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], where they fitted [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|biosynthetic prosthetic]] [[Limb/Legends|hand]] after his was severed in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].
